_info: Bruno at the desk (AIMA and Finanças sim): what customers say at the Junta de Freguesia, the centro de saúde, Finanças, Segurança Social and AIMA of the invented town of Vilabruno. European Portuguese at A2 (variety pt-PT, the content being learnt) in `de` (key kept), the English meaning in `en`. Humour about paperwork and queues, never about people or where they come from. pt-BR note: Brazilian speakers would use more 'você' and 'ônibus/celular' type words; none of that appears here.

gruss.de: Bom dia. Finalmente chegou a minha vez.
gruss.en: Good morning. My turn at last.

gruss.de: Boa tarde. Uf, que fila tão grande hoje!
gruss.en: Good afternoon. Phew, what a long queue today!
Hello. I hope I’ve brought everything.

gruss.de: Bom dia. Aqui tem a minha senha.

genehmigt.de: Ótimo, muito obrigado! Tenha um bom dia!
genehmigt.en: Great, thank you very much! Have a nice day!

genehmigt.de: Obrigado. E eu a pensar que me faltava alguma coisa!
genehmigt.en: Thanks. And I thought I was missing something!

abgelehnt.de: Ah, está bem. Compreendo. Volto quando o tiver.
abgelehnt.en: Oh, OK. I understand. I’ll come back when I have it.

abgelehnt.de: Que pena! Bem, não faz mal. Vou buscá-lo.
abgelehnt.en: Oh dear! Well, never mind. I’ll go and get it.

abgelehnt.de: Os papéis, sempre os papéis … Mas tem razão. Até logo!
abgelehnt.en: Paperwork, always paperwork … But you’re right. See you later!

abgelehnt.de: Está bem, obrigado por me explicar. Volto outro dia.
abgelehnt.en: All right, thanks for explaining. I’ll come back another day.

zurueck.de: Estou aqui outra vez. Agora trago tudo.
zurueck.en: I’m back again. This time I have everything.

zurueck.de: Olá de novo. Veja, já o tenho.
zurueck.en: Hello again. Look, I’ve got it now.

warten.en: Excuse me, will it take long?
